description: Legal document in Hebrew. Location: Fustat. Dated: Wednesday, 28 Iyyar 5374 AM = 7 May 1614 CE. Involving a debt; the parties include [...] b. David Shemuʾel (? שמול) and ʿEzer and Yisraʾel and a sum of 500 of some currency for a purchase of 20 "kikarim" of raisins (צמוקין). Reused on verso for unrelated literary material.
description_he: מסמך משפטי בעברית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
